title: Good morning! I hope you had...
content_text:
Good morning! I hope you had a restful weekend.
Let us kick off the meeting by reviewing the action items from last week.
I have pushed the latest changes to the feature branch, could you take a look when you get a chance?
The client is expecting the delivery by end of day Thursday, so we need to stay on track.
If anyone runs into blockers, please flag them early so we can adjust the plan.
